parsed.title: Validator mismatch for AC7
parsed.detail: AC7 claims to verify that 'every surface the census shows routing the class' names the router and the same planner command, and that no surface sends a replan row to the executor or the fold. However, the validator only greps for 'unit-route' across 8 skill files and 6 tutorial files. It does not check if the destination is the executor or the fold, nor does it verify the planner command matches.

parsed.title: Incomplete destination census in Scope
parsed.detail: The 'In scope' section enumerates 8 skill files and 3 tutorial pairs (total 14) as the destination census. However, the 'Impact' section and the 'Affected docs' table in the same SPEC include 'docs/workflow/SKILLS.md' and 'docs/workflow/SKILLS.es.md', which are not part of the 14 enumerated in the Scope census.
